protocol.scope: Exploratory retrospective study on the already-inspected archive. Settings written before running this new experiment; not a preregistered or fresh holdout claim.
protocol.primary_score: Mean negative log probability of the full unordered six-ball set and strong number; compare with log(7*C(37,6))

synthetic.construction: Ball 1 included with probability multiplier*6/37 after bias_starts; remaining balls uniform conditional on inclusion; strong number uniform.
synthetic.interpretation: Finite Monte Carlo sensitivity and null checks for each fixed detector, not a claim about bias in real draws. Historical archive ratios are exploratory; formal future monitoring requires freezing the algorithm before future outcomes.

coverage_probe.purpose: Check whether the previous two-pass cap leaves easy coverage gains; not simulated annealing or a global-optimum claim.

limits: No remote compute or seed campaign
Do not select or retune settings based on the new real-data results
Keep production prediction defaults unchanged until prospective evidence

bootstrap.scope: exploratory, individual intervals, not family corrected
